subject: Английский язык
authors: Биболетова М. З., Денисенко О. А., Tрубанева Н. Н.

chapters.title: 1. Speaking about seasons and the weather. Section 1. What is your favourite season?

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 1, с. 5. Послушай и повтори слова и словосочетания.
steps: dive — нырять, jump — прыгать, make a snowman — лепить снеговика, play badminton / basketball / football / hockey / snowballs / table tennis / volleyball — играть в бадминтон / баскетбол / футбол / хоккей / снежки / настольный теннис / волейбол, ride a bike — кататься на велосипеде, run — бегать, skate — кататься на коньках, ski — на лыжах, swim — плавать, toboggan — кататься на санках.
problems.answer: dive, jump, make a snowman, play badminton / basketball / football / hockey / snowballs / table tennis / volleyball, ride a bike, run, skate, ski, swim, toboggan.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 2, с. 5. Ответь на вопросы: что можно делать только зимой, только летом, в любое время года?
steps: Зимой: make a snowman, play snowballs, ski, toboggan. Летом: dive, swim, ride a bike. В любое время: jump, run, play badminton, football, hockey, table tennis, volleyball, skate.
problems.answer: Winter — make a snowman, play snowballs, ski, toboggan; summer — dive, swim, ride a bike; any season — jump, run, play games, skate.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 3, с. 6. a) Задай одноклассникам вопросы. b) Заполни таблицу их ответами.
steps: a) Do you like to play hockey / toboggan / skate / play snowballs in winter? Do you like to swim / dive / ride a bike / run in summer? What do you like to do in summer / winter?
b) Отмечаем в таблице плюсы и минусы по ответам одноклассников.
problems.answer: Do you like to skate in winter? Do you like to swim in summer? What do you like to do in winter / summer? — ответы заносим в таблицу.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 4, с. 6. Расскажи, что любит делать один из одноклассников.
steps: Пример: He likes to skate and play snowballs in winter. He likes to swim, play tennis and run in summer.
problems.answer: He likes to skate and play snowballs in winter. He likes to swim and run in summer.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 5, с. 6. Послушай запись и скажи, чем любят заниматься ребята.
steps: Bill likes to ride a bike in summer and skate in winter. Mike likes to toboggan in winter and play badminton in summer.
problems.answer: Bill — ride a bike (summer), skate (winter); Mike — toboggan (winter), play badminton (summer).

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 6, с. 7. Послушай слова и прочитай их вслух.
steps: clock, cloudy, down, duck, frog, hot, jump, mouth, not, now, on, spring, summer, sunny, windy, winter.
problems.answer: clock, cloudy, down, duck, frog, hot, jump, mouth, not, now, on, spring, summer, sunny, windy, winter.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 7, с. 7. Посмотри на картинки и догадайся о значении слов.
steps: cloudy — пасмурно, cold — холодно, hot — жарко, snowy — снежно, sunny — солнечно, windy — ветрено.
problems.answer: cloudy, cold, hot, snowy, sunny, windy.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 8, с. 7. Прочитай текст и ответь на вопрос: кого встретили утки?
steps: They see a frog.
problems.answer: They see a frog.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 9, с. 8. Прочитай текст и расставь картинки в правильном порядке.
steps: Правильный порядок картинок — C.
problems.answer: C.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 10, с. 8. Прочитай текст и ответь на вопросы.
steps: The frog and two ducks live in the river. She likes to talk. No, because it's cold and snowy in winter. Because the frog asked them to take her to Africa. They say: «Don't speak!» They see a clock.
It is autumn now. I don't like this season because it is cloudy, windy and cold.
problems.answer: In the river; she likes to talk; no, winter is cold; the frog asked them to take her to Africa; «Don't speak!»; a clock. It's autumn now — I don't like it because it's cloudy and cold.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 11, с. 8. Разыграй диалог снегиря и зайца.
steps: — Why do you like winter? — I like winter because it's white and snowy.
problems.answer: — Why do you like winter? — Because it's white and snowy.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 12, с. 9. Скажи, какое время года тебе нравится, а какое нет.
steps: I like summer because it's hot and sunny. I like spring because it's warm and green. I don't like autumn because it's rainy and cloudy. I don't like winter because it's cold and snowy.
problems.answer: I like summer because it's hot and sunny. I like spring because it's warm. I don't like autumn because it's rainy. I don't like winter because it's cold.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 13, с. 9. Послушай стишок о временах года и выучи его.
steps: Зимой холодно и снежно, летом солнечно и приятно, осенью пасмурно и дождливо, а весной можно допрыгнуть до неба.
problems.answer: Стишок: winter — cold and snowy, summer — sunny and nice, autumn — cloudy and rainy, spring — I can jump to the sky.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 14, с. 9. Заполни пропуски.
steps: windy, cold and snowy; sunny and hot; rainy and cloudy; warm and sunny.
problems.answer: windy, cold and snowy; sunny and hot; rainy and cloudy; warm and sunny.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 15, с. 10. Дополни предложения.
steps: can read books; can ski and skate; can walk in the park; can draw pictures; can dive and swim; can play with my friends.
problems.answer: can read books; can ski and skate; can walk in the park; can draw pictures; can dive and swim; can play with my friends.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 16, с. 10. Расположи реплики по порядку, послушай и прочитай диалог.
steps: — Hi! I'm from Russia. Where are you from? — Hi! I'm from Great Britain. — What is the weather like in winter in Great Britain? — It's rainy and windy! And in Russia? — It's cold and snowy! — Great! I like winter in Russia!
problems.answer: — I'm from Russia. Where are you from? — From Great Britain. — What's the weather like in winter there? — Rainy and windy! And in Russia? — Cold and snowy! — Great!

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 17, с. 10. Расскажите друг другу о погоде в ваших странах.
steps: — I live in Russia. Where are you from? — I live in Africa. — We have four seasons. In winter it is snowy and frosty. — We only have summer. It's always hot, sunny and dry. — In winter we ski or play snowballs. — We swim and wear light clothes.
problems.answer: — In Russia we have four seasons; in winter it's snowy and frosty. — In Africa it's always hot and sunny.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 18, с. 10. Расскажи о погоде в твоём крае в разное время года и о том, что ты любишь делать.
steps: Пример: I live in Russia. We have four seasons. Spring is warm and beautiful. Summer is sunny and hot — we go to the sea and swim. In autumn it is rainy and cloudy, I like walking in rubber boots. In winter it is snowy and frosty — we ski, skate and play snowballs.
problems.answer: Spring — warm; summer — hot, we swim; autumn — rainy; winter — snowy, we ski and play snowballs.

chapters.title: 1. Speaking about seasons and the weather. Section 2. Speaking about the future

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 19, с. 11. Послушай запись и скажи, где Тайни и какая там погода.
steps: Tiny is in Africa now. It's sunny and hot in Africa.
problems.answer: He is in Africa. It's sunny and hot.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 20, с. 11. Прочитай историю и скажи, есть ли у Ослика любимое время года.
steps: The Donkey hasn't got a favourite season — ему что-то не нравится в каждом.
problems.answer: No, the Donkey hasn't got a favourite season.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 21, с. 12. Прочитай историю и скажи, какие предложения верны (true), а какие нет (false).
steps: true, false, true, false, true.
problems.answer: true, false, true, false, true.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 22, с. 12. Найди в тексте предложения, которые описывают картинки из упражнения 20.
steps: It's winter now. It's cold and snowy. The Donkey is sad. Spring is coming. It's warm and sunny. The Donkey is in the park. Summer comes. It's hot. The Donkey is sad again. Autumn comes. It's cloudy and rainy. The Donkey has got a lot of apples and carrots.
problems.answer: Winter — cold and snowy, the Donkey is sad; spring — warm, in the park; summer — hot, sad again; autumn — rainy, a lot of apples and carrots.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 23, с. 12. Прочитай и переведи предложения (будущее время will).
steps: Я сделаю домашнее задание через час. Завтра мы будем играть в баскетбол. Она пришлёт мне открытку на следующей неделе. Следующая зима будет снежной. Они приедут в Россию в следующем году.
problems.answer: will — будущее время: сделаю, будем играть, пришлёт, будет, приедут.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 24, с. 12. Скажи, что ты будешь делать в следующем году (зимой, весной, летом, осенью).
steps: I will swim in the river next summer. I will visit a museum next autumn. I will ski next winter. I will walk in the park next spring.
problems.answer: I will swim next summer, visit a museum next autumn, ski next winter, walk in the park next spring.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 25, с. 13. Расположи реплики в правильном порядке.
steps: 1) — Would you like to play football today? — I'm sorry, I'm very busy. — What about tomorrow morning? — Tomorrow is fine. 2) — Which is your favourite season? — I think autumn. — Why autumn? — Because I like apples very much.
problems.answer: 1) Would you like to play football today? — I'm sorry, I'm busy. — What about tomorrow? — Fine. 2) Which is your favourite season? — Autumn. — Why? — Because I like apples.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 26, с. 13. Послушай и прочитай диалоги.
steps: Читаем диалоги за диктором: о приглашении поиграть в футбол и о любимом времени года.
problems.answer: Диалоги читаются по записи.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 27, с. 13. Дополни предложения о погоде (It will be …).
steps: It will be warm today. It will be rainy today. It will be sunny today.
problems.answer: It will be warm / rainy / sunny today.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 28, с. 13. Придумай прогноз погоды на зимние месяцы, используя слова из рамки.
steps: I think December will be snowy. I think January will be cold. I think February will be windy.
problems.answer: December will be snowy, January will be cold, February will be windy.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 29, с. 14. Заполни пропуски в предложениях.
steps: I'll play with you tomorrow. I'll walk with you in the park in an hour. I'll play badminton with you next summer. I'll dance for you next week. I'll play snowballs with you next winter.
problems.answer: tomorrow, in an hour, next summer, next week, next winter.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 30, с. 14. Напиши, что ты будешь делать завтра, используя фразы из таблицы.
steps: I'll send a postcard to a friend tomorrow. I'll help Mum tomorrow. I'll listen to music tomorrow.
problems.answer: I'll send a postcard to a friend, help Mum and listen to music tomorrow.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 31, с. 15. Спроси одноклассника, что он будет делать завтра.
steps: Will you help your mum tomorrow? — Yes, I will. Will you send a postcard to a friend? — Yes, I will. Will you visit your grandmother? — No, I won't. Will you play table tennis? — Yes, I will. Will you play computer games? — No, I won't.
problems.answer: Will you help your mum / send a postcard / visit your grandmother / play table tennis tomorrow? — Yes, I will. / No, I won't.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 32, с. 15. Прочитай план Тайни на неделю и скажи, что, по-твоему, он не сделает.
steps: I think he won't build a new house on Monday. He won't write 10 fairy tales on Tuesday. He won't learn Russian on Wednesday. He won't send 200 postcards on Thursday. He won't clean his house and watch TV on Friday. He won't visit his doctor on Saturday. He won't make ninety-nine cakes on Sunday.
problems.answer: I think he won't build a house, write 10 fairy tales, learn Russian, send 200 postcards or make 99 cakes.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 33, с. 15. Спроси Тайни о его планах, используя will, where, why, when, what.
steps: Will you play computer games next week? Where will you play table tennis on Sunday? Why will you send a postcard on Wednesday? When will you visit your grandmother? What will you do on Monday?
problems.answer: Will you play computer games? Where will you play table tennis? Why will you send a postcard? When will you visit your grandmother? What will you do on Monday?

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 34, с. 15. Расскажи о планах на зимние и летние каникулы.
steps: I'll play snowballs and go to the skating rink in winter. I'll play football and go to the seaside in summer.
problems.answer: In winter I'll play snowballs and skate. In summer I'll play football and go to the seaside.

chapters.title: 1. Speaking about seasons and the weather. Section 3. When the weather is fine…

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 35, с. 16. Посмотри на карту и скажи, какая будет погода завтра.
steps: In Pskov it will be rainy. In Tomsk it will be cloudy. In Yakutsk it will be sunny. In Moscow it will be hot. In Kazan it will be windy.
problems.answer: Pskov — rainy, Tomsk — cloudy, Yakutsk — sunny, Moscow — hot, Kazan — windy.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 36, с. 16. Послушай прогноз погоды и проверь себя.
steps: Прогноз на завтра: Pskov — rainy, Moscow — hot, Tomsk — cloudy, Kazan — windy, Yakutsk — sunny.
problems.answer: Pskov — rainy, Moscow — hot, Tomsk — cloudy, Kazan — windy, Yakutsk — sunny.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 37, с. 16. Скажи, какая погода будет завтра в твоём городе.
steps: I think it will be cold and windy tomorrow.
problems.answer: I think the weather will be cold and windy tomorrow.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 38, с. 16. Прочитай письмо и скажи, любит ли Джилл зиму.
steps: No, Jill doesn't like winter.
problems.answer: No, she doesn't.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 39, с. 17. Выбери правильный ответ и прочитай вслух.
steps: B, A, A, B, C.
problems.answer: B, A, A, B, C.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 40, с. 17. Закончи предложения.
steps: Dad and Jim will fly a kite. Mum and Jill will play hide-and-seek. They will have a picnic.
problems.answer: Dad and Jim will fly a kite. Mum and Jill will play hide-and-seek. They will have a picnic.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 41, с. 17. Прочитай письмо Джилл и ответь на её вопросы.
steps: My favourite season is spring. I like to ride a bike in the park and play badminton. I will go to the skating rink next winter.
problems.answer: My favourite season is spring. I like to ride a bike and play badminton. I will go skating next winter.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 3, упр. 42, с. 17. Скажи, что вы будете делать на пикнике.
steps: We will fly a kite. We will play hide-and-seek and catch-up. We will have sandwiches and tea.
problems.answer: We will fly a kite, play hide-and-seek and have sandwiches and tea.

chapters.title: 1. Speaking about seasons and the weather. Section 4. Writing at home

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 4, упр. 1, с. 18. Ответь на вопросы: что ты любишь делать зимой и летом?
steps: I like to ski, skate and play snowballs in winter. I like to swim, fly a kite and ride a bike in summer.
problems.answer: In winter I like to ski, skate and play snowballs. In summer I like to swim, fly a kite and ride a bike.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 4, упр. 2, с. 18. Прочитай текст упражнения 8 на с. 7 и закончи предложения.
steps: The frog likes to chat very much. The ducks like summer because it's hot and sunny. The ducks say to the frog: «You must not speak! Don't open your mouth!»
problems.answer: likes to chat; like summer because it's hot and sunny; «Don't open your mouth!»

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 4, упр. 3, с. 18. Ответь на вопрос о любимом времени года.
steps: I like summer because it's hot and sunny. I can swim in the river and fly a kite.
problems.answer: I like summer because it's hot and sunny. I can swim and fly a kite.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 4, упр. 4, с. 18. Выбери нужный глагол и запиши предложения.
steps: He'll draw a funny picture for his sister tomorrow. I have breakfast at 8 a.m. every day. We'll help you in an hour. It'll be snowy and cold next winter. They'll play computer games next week. She listens to music every Sunday.
problems.answer: 'll draw, have, 'll help, 'll be, 'll play, listens.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 4, упр. 5, с. 18. Напиши, что ты будешь делать завтра и на следующей неделе.
steps: I'll walk in the park tomorrow. I'll play computer games tomorrow. I'll ride a bike next week. I'll go to school next week.
problems.answer: Tomorrow I'll walk in the park and play computer games. Next week I'll ride a bike and go to school.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 4, упр. 6, с. 18. Выбери will или won't.
steps: The forest will be green in spring. The children won't skate and play hockey in summer. Jill won't have a picnic in winter. Tomorrow it will be windy. Jim will fly a kite. Tiny will be busy. He won't play tennis tomorrow. He will help Billy.
problems.answer: will, won't, won't, will, will, will, won't, will.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 4, упр. 7, с. 19. Ответь на письмо Джилл: расскажи о своём любимом времени года.
steps: Dear Jill, thank you for your letter. You ask me about my favourite season. I like summer. It's hot and sunny. I like to swim and ride a bike in summer. I like to have picnics in the park. Winter is nice too: it will be cold and snowy, and I will play snowballs and toboggan. Write back. Yours, …
problems.answer: Dear Jill, my favourite season is summer — it's hot and sunny, I swim and ride a bike. Next winter I will play snowballs and toboggan. Yours, …

problems.condition: Unit 1, Section 4, с. 19. Повтори слова раздела.
steps: hide-and-seek — прятки, kite — воздушный змей, picnic — пикник, rain — дождь, snow — снег, snowball — снежок, snowman — снеговик, year — год, tomorrow — завтра, next week / year — на следующей неделе / в следующем году.
Погода: cold — холодно, cloudy — пасмурно, hot — жарко, rainy — дождливо, snowy — снежно, sunny — солнечно, warm — тепло, windy — ветрено.
problems.answer: hide-and-seek, kite, picnic, rain, snow, snowball, snowman, year, tomorrow, next week; cold, cloudy, hot, rainy, snowy, sunny, warm, windy.

chapters.title: 1. Speaking about seasons and the weather. Test yourself 1

problems.condition: Unit 1. Test yourself 1, упр. 1, с. 19. Посмотри на картинки и скажи, какая на них погода.
steps: It is winter. It is cold, frosty and snowy. It is spring. It is sunny. It is summer. It is hot and sunny. It is autumn. It is cold and rainy.
problems.answer: winter — cold and snowy; spring — sunny; summer — hot and sunny; autumn — cold and rainy.

problems.condition: Unit 1. Test yourself 1, упр. 2, с. 19. Посмотри на картинки, прочитай предложения и выбери правильный вариант.
steps: Dino can skate. Tiny and Billy like to toboggan. Martin and Tiny can make a snowman. Jim can fly a kite. Jack and Donkey like to play hide-and-seek. Dino can dive.
problems.answer: Dino can skate. Tiny and Billy like to toboggan. Martin and Tiny can make a snowman. Jim can fly a kite. Jack and Donkey like to play hide-and-seek. Dino can dive.

problems.condition: Unit 1. Test yourself 1, упр. 3, с. 19. Вставь пропущенные слова.
steps: sunny, park, picnic, fly.
problems.answer: sunny, park, picnic, fly.

problems.condition: Unit 1. Test yourself 1, упр. 4, с. 19. Составь предложения из слов.
steps: My grandpa will go to the post office in an hour. Jim won't ride a bike in the evening. Will you play badminton tomorrow? When will they visit their granny?
problems.answer: My grandpa will go to the post office in an hour. Jim won't ride a bike in the evening. Will you play badminton tomorrow? When will they visit their granny?

problems.condition: Unit 1. Test yourself 1, упр. 5, с. 19. Прочитай вопросы и дай краткие ответы.
steps: No, I don't. No, she can't. Yes, I am. No, she doesn't. Yes, she has. No, they won't. Yes, they do.
problems.answer: No, I don't. No, she can't. Yes, I am. No, she doesn't. Yes, she has. No, they won't. Yes, they do.

problems.condition: Unit 1. Test yourself 1, упр. 6, с. 19. Прочитай письмо, посмотри на рисунки и впиши недостающие слова.
steps: snowy, toboggan, snowman, ski, ski.
problems.answer: snowy, toboggan, snowman, ski, ski.

chapters.title: Unit 2. Enjoying your home. Section 1. Describing your house

problems.condition: Unit 2, Section 1, упр. 1, с. 20. Рассмотри картинку домика, послушай запись и выучи новые слова.
steps: hall — коридор, kitchen — кухня, pantry — кладовая, living room — гостиная, bedroom — спальня, bathroom — ванная, toilet — туалет, window — окно, wall — стена, door — дверь.
problems.answer: hall, kitchen, pantry, living room, bedroom, bathroom, toilet, window, wall, door.

problems.condition: Unit 2, Section 1, упр. 2, с. 21. Скажи, сколько комнат в доме Браунов, и назови их.
steps: They have got six rooms: a living room, a hall, a bedroom, a bathroom, a toilet and a kitchen.
problems.answer: Six rooms: living room, hall, bedroom, bathroom, toilet, kitchen.

problems.condition: Unit 2, Section 1, упр. 3, с. 21. Послушай запись и прочитай слова.
steps: Читаем слова по теме «Дом» за диктором.
problems.answer: Слова читаются за диктором.

problems.condition: Unit 2, Section 1, упр. 4, с. 21. Послушай диалог и разыграй его по ролям.
steps: — Have you got your own room? — Yes, I have. But it isn't very big. Have you got your own room? — No, I share a room with my sister. — Do you live in a flat or in a house? — We live in a flat.
problems.answer: — Have you got your own room? — Yes, but it's small. — I share a room with my sister. — Do you live in a flat or a house? — In a flat.

problems.condition: Unit 2, Section 1, упр. 5, с. 21. Задай вопросы одноклассникам и заполни таблицу.
steps: Have you got your own room? Do you share your room? Have you got a big room or a small room? Do you live in a flat or in a house?
problems.answer: Have you got your own room? Do you share your room? Is your room big or small? Do you live in a flat or a house?

problems.condition: Unit 2, Section 1, упр. 6, с. 21. Скажи, сколько комнат в твоей квартире.
steps: Пример: I have got two rooms in my flat. There is a hall, a bathroom, a kitchen and two bedrooms.
problems.answer: I have got two rooms in my flat: a hall, a bathroom, a kitchen and two bedrooms.

problems.condition: Unit 2, Section 1, упр. 7, с. 22. Заполни пропуски (there is / there are).

problems.answer: Summer — play hide-and-seek, have picnics, fly kites, eat fruit; winter — make a snowman, play snowballs.
